up: Find drugs that are approved (max_phase = 4) but have indications that only reached Phase III (max_phase_for_ind = 3). Return the drug name, ChEMBL ID, MeSH heading, and EFO term for those indications. Do not include drugs where any indication reached Phase 4 or higher.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 3
